extension.summary: 显示自定义播放器进程信息
extension.description: Öffnet ein eigenes Prozessinformationen-Fenster. Dieses enthält Codec-, Video- und Audio-Details zum aktuell abgespielten Medium.
Opens a separate process information window. This window displays codec, video, and audio details for the currently playing media.
打开一个独立的进程信息窗口。此窗口显示当前播放媒体的编解码器、视频和音频详细信息。
extension.news: v1.6.1.1 - Merged upstream v1.6.1 (single-layout rewrite, new theme wiring, tools.tinyppi-provided binaries). - Re-added the right-side speaker channel graphic and codec/HDR logo stack (ppicodecs) removed upstream, at the original Modern positions; UIStyle gating dropped as the Modern/Classic switch no longer exists. - Fixed fonts.py: register NotoSans-Regular/Bold.ttf (the files tools.tinyppi 1.0.3 actually ships; upstream referenced non-existent Noto-*.ttf), and update stale same-name Font.xml entries in place instead of appending duplicates (converts old Inter-*.ttf entries from 1.5.x).
